raw.unit: Material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity must be documented by submission of one or more of the documents listed in this section

context_quotes: (see an exception for married names in 8 FAM 403.1-4(C))
alternative_quotes: Court orders or decrees: (a) Name change orders; or (b) Divorce decrees;
Documentation demonstrating change of name by operation of state law; or
unit_attributes.choice_quote: one or more of the documents listed in this section
unit_attributes.choice_text: one or more of: court orders or decrees (name change orders or divorce decrees); certificates of naturalization; marriage certificates; documentation demonstrating change of name by operation of state law; or documentation of customary usage
unit_attributes.object_quote: Material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity
unit_attributes.object: material discrepancies between the application name, citizenship/nationality evidence, or identity evidence
unit_attributes.summary: Material discrepancies between the name on the application and the evidence of citizenship/nationality or identity must be documented by submitting one or more listed documents.
